description: the current version of another user's survey: an empty 400, as for an unknown version
difference: The old API found the survey and answered 400 "You are not authorized to publish the survey version dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-a00000000001."; Studio does not show another user's survey, so the bridge answers as for a version no survey has, as getSurveyInfo does (docs/api/legacy-compat.md).
